# BTicino C300X Integration v2.8.0

## Better camera picture

The camera picture can now be clearly better than from the factory. Under
**Configure > Camera quality** you choose:

- **Sharper:** up to 3000 kbit/s instead of 800.
- **Smoother:** up to 24 frames per second instead of 15. 25 is not offered,
  because the device then sends only about 8.
- **More picture:** the whole 720x576 camera picture instead of the factory
  688x480 cut-out. The size also applies to the camera picture on the C300X
  display and to answering-machine recordings.

The C300X reads these values only when it starts, so saving a change restarts
it once, which takes about a minute. The form shows the values saved on the
device and the ones it runs with. Removing the agent puts the original values
back. Needs the agent update.

On firmware 3.0.6 the area sets the low-resolution stream, the only one that
firmware sends, which the Door Entry app receives as well: sizes from 352x288
to 720x576, 100-2000 kbit/s and up to 25 frames per second. Sizes other than
the factory 400x288 are not tested on a 3.0.6 device yet.

## Tip: clearer sound with PCMU

If your C300X runs the factory Speex codec (firmware 1.7.19 and 2.0.2), set the **Audio codec**
select to **PCMU**. The browser plays PCMU as it is, so the agent no longer
converts the sound; that gives clearer audio and leaves the device more room.
Switching restarts the C300X once. The switch writes the same codec settings
BTicino itself ships on firmware 3.0.6, which already runs PCMU from the
factory.
